body.name: labelled rational-elimination transition
body.construction: Write \(\zeta\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}}\zeta'\) iff the least \(\ell=(\operatorname{op},L,Z)\in\mathcal L\) passes one of two exact tests. For \(\operatorname{op}=\operatorname{sum}\), require nonempty \(Z\subseteq R\setminus\operatorname{an}(Y)\) and replace the labelled product by \(\sum_Z\prod_{k\in L}K_k\), removing \(Z\) from \(R\). For \(\operatorname{op}=\operatorname{district}\), require that the induced CADMG on the vertices named by \(L\) has at least two proper districts and replace the product by the canonically ordered district kernels obtained from the fixed topological quotient; each child mask is a strict subset of the parent mask. Delete exactly \(\ell\), cancel common factors, and admit each sign-normalized reduced denominator to \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{elim}}\) only with an exact factorization into a positive rational constant, earlier selector or fixing denominators, and nonempty sums of branch-reachable positive kernel cells. The emitted objects are the sum or factor circuits and their denominator factorizations. The local obligations are the corresponding expanded polynomial identity modulo \(\mathcal J\), checked after cross-multiplication, and every ledger factorization identity.
